title: August and the Language
author: Felix Yarrow
blurb: Quentin Coldharbour, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
